notes.title: "Life of a caveman" status
notes.content:
After 4 years of on and off development, more off than on, "Life of a caveman" seems to be slowly moving in the right direction. 
I would expect some sort of beta test in a few months, if everything goes well.
I understand the development time was/is a bit long.
I guess that things that you have to wait for seem more enjoyable when you actually get them.
I intend to take the game into a more survival focus rather than social focus as initially planned.
What do you think about that?
Also I plan to upload more dev screenshots on the Facebook page, here: [url=https://www.facebook.com/Life-of-a-caveman-1732477367014414]https://www.facebook.com/Life-of-a-caveman-1732477367014414[/url]
